def load():

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

import numpy as np, os, re
from collections import defaultdict,Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

    H,W=I.shape
    bg=Counter(I.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seeds=[(r,c,int(I[r,c])) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r,c]!=bg]
    tab=[]
    for p in np.argwhere(I!=O):
        r,c=int(p[0]),int(p[1]); new=int(O[r,c])
        best=min(seeds,key=lambda s:max(abs(s[0]-r),abs(s[1]-c)))
        tab.append((best[2],new,r-best[0],c-best[1]))
    from collections import defaultdict
    cc=defaultdict(Counter)
    for sc,new,dr,dc in tab: cc[(sc,new)][(dr,dc)]+=1

        common={o:n for o,n in vv.items() if n>=3}
        print('  ',key,'common:',common, 'total:',sum(vv.values()))

import numpy as np
from collections import deque
def comps(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if (r,c) in seen or g[r][c]==1: continue
            col=g[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                a,b=q.popleft(); cells.append((a,b))
                for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=a+dr,b+dc
                    if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and (x,y) not in seen and g[x][y]==col:

def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]

                for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=a+dr,b+dc
                    if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and (x,y) not in seen and g[x][y]==col:
                        seen.add((x,y)); q.append((x,y))
            out.append((col,cells))
    return out

import numpy as np
from collections import deque, Counter
def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]

                for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=a+dr,b+dc
                    if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and (x,y) not in seen and g[x][y]==col:

import numpy as np
from collections import deque, Counter
I,O=G['Demo pair 7 input'],G['Demo pair 7 output']
H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if (r,c) in seen or g[r][c]==bg: continue
            col=g[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                a,b=q.popleft(); cells.append((a,b))
                for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=a+dr,b+dc
                    if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and (x,y) not in seen and g[x][y]==col:
                        seen.add((x,y)); q.append((x,y))
            out.append((col,cells))
    return out
cs=comps(I,9)
objs=[(cc,cl) for cc,cl in cs if len(cl)>=2]
singles=[(sc,p) for sc_,p in [(cc,cl[0]) for cc,cl in cs if len(cl)==1]]
# Rule candidate: for each single, stamp nearest object shape with bbox TL at the SINGLE'S position, colored with the OBJECT's color.
def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in I for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(I,bg)
    objs=[(cc,cl) for cc,cl in cs if len(cl)>=2]
    singles=[(cc,p) for cc,cl in cs if len(cl)==1 for p in cl]
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    for sc,(xr,xc) in singles:
        nobj=min(objs,key=lambda t:min(abs(xr-r)+abs(xc-c) for r,c in t[1]))
        mr=min(r for r,c in nobj[1]); mc=min(c for r,c in nobj[1])
        S=[(r-mr,c-mc) for r,c in nobj[1]]
        for r,c in S:
            rr,cc_=xr+r, xc+c
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc_<W and I[rr][cc_]==bg:
                out[rr][cc_]=nobj[0]
    return out
P=solve(G['Demo pair 7 input']); O=G['Demo pair 7 output']
print('match:', P==O)
if P!=O:
    d=[(r,c,I[r][c],O[r][c],P[r][c]) for r in range(len(I)) for c in range(len(I[0])) if P[r][c]!=O[r][c]]
    print('ndiff',len(d),d[:12])

from collections import deque, Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps(g,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if (r,c) in seen or g[r][c]==bg: continue
            col=g[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while q:
                a,b=q.popleft(); cells.append((a,b))
                for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=a+dr,b+dc
                    if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and (x,y) not in seen and g[x][y]==col:
                        seen.add((x,y)); q.append((x,y))
            out.append((col,cells))
    return out
for k in range(1,9):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {k} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in I for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(I,bg)
    objs=[(cc,cl) for cc,cl in cs if len(cl)>=2]
    singles=[(cc,cl[0]) for cc,cl in cs if len(cl)==1]
    print(f'--- demo {k}: bg={bg}; nobjs={len(objs)}; nsingles={len(singles)}')
    # changed cells per demo
    ch=[(r,c,I[r][c],O[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=O[r][c]]
    print(' changed:',len(ch))
    # describe object shapes
    shps=[]
    for cc,cl in objs:
        rs=[a for a,b in cl]; cs_=[b for a,b in cl]
        shps.append((cc,min(rs),min(cs_),max(rs)-min(rs)+1,max(cs_)-min(cs_)+1,len(cl)))
    print(' obj shapes(color,r0,c0,h,w,n):',shps)

from collections import deque, Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for p in range(1,9):

    H=len(I); W=len(I[0]); bg=Counter(v for row in I for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    ci=comps(I,bg); co=comps(O,bg)
    nin=sum(c==[] for c in ci); nout=sum(c==[] for c in co)
    # count added cells (new comps or larger comps)
    same=set()
    for c in ci: same.add(norm(c))
    added=sum(1 for c in co if norm(c) not in same and len(c)>1)
    # match by inclusion
    grown=0; created=0
    for c in ci:
        anchor=min(c)
        matched=[o for o in co if anchor in o]
        if matched: grown+=1
        else: created+=1
    for c in co:
        anchor=min(c)
        matched=[o for o in ci if anchor in o]
        if not matched: created+=1
    print(f'pair{p}: in_n={len(ci)} out_n={len(co)} grew={grown} created={created}')

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter,defaultdict,deque
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# Object-based rule: each OBJECT grows one cell toward nearest OTHER OBJECT; new cell = that other object's dominant color. Verify per pair now.
def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); bg=Counter(v for row in I for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; objs=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]!=bg and not seen[r][c]:
                st=deque([(r,c)]); comp=[]; seen[r][c]=True
                while st:
                    a,b=st.popleft(); comp.append((a,b,I[a][b]))
                    for dr,dc in ((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
                        n=(a+dr,b+dc)
                        if 0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W and I[n[0]][n[1]]!=bg and not seen[n[0]][n[1]]:
                            seen[n[0]][n[1]]=True; st.append(n)
                objs.append(comp)
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    # order processing so later changes don't confuse? try both orders; also skip cells occupied by existing objects or another new cell -> check collisions separately
    for oidx,o in enumerate(objs):
        best=None
        for j,o2 in enumerate(objs):
            if j==oiIdx:=oidx: continue
            dist=min(abs(a-b)+abs(c-d) for a,b in o for c,d in o2)
            if best is None or dist<best[0]: best=(dist,j)
        if best is None: continue
        dist,j=best
        other=objs[j]
        avo=Counter(I[a][b] for a,b in other).most_common(1)[0][0]
        # direction: from anchor cell (choose the object cell closest to other obj?) toward other obj's centroid
        cr=sum(b for b,_ in other)/len(other); cc=sum(b for _,b in other)/len(other)
        ar=sum(a for a,_ in o)/len(o); ac=sum(c for _,c in o)/len(o)
        dr_= 1 if cr>ar else -1 if cr<ar else 0
        dc_= 1 if cc>ac else -1 if cc<ac else 0
        pr,pc=int(ar)+dr_,int(ac)+dc_
        # snap: ensure target neighbor adjacent to some object cell? allow any single step along dominant axis of offset vector
        dr_= 1 if int(cr)>int(ar) else -1 if int(cr)<int(ar) else 0
        dc_= 1 if int(cc)>int(ac) else -1 if int(cc)<int(ac) else 0
        pr,pc=int(ar)+dr_,int(ac)+dc_
        if 0<=pr<H and 0<=pc<W and I[pr][pc]==bg:
            O[pr][pc]=avo
    return O
for p in [1,2,3,4,7]:
    I=G[f'Demo pair {p} input'];O=G[f'Demo pair {p} output']
    R=f(I)
    print('pair',p,'match' if R==O else 'MISMATCH')
